chunks: That this is indeed the word of an honoured Messenger,
ai.seo_question: Who is the honoured messenger referred to in Surah Al-Takwir?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah al-Takwir, this verse serves as a divine rebuttal to the disbelievers who attributed the Quran to a poet or madman, clarifying that the source is Jibril, the honoured Messenger. Shia exegesis emphasizes the purity and nobility of this Messenger, linking his status to the infallibility of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) in receiving and conveying the revelation without error.
